answer.rationale: Finance mandate requires an 18% cut and the low-cost vendor's quote already meets it; switching unlocks immediate unit-cost reduction. I want to confirm c2 (successful past switch to low-cost vendor with accurate invoicing) and c6 (multi-year commitments to incumbent unlocked volume pricing), because that same lever may now apply to the low-cost vendor. With the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, c6-style term leverage can secure pricing without trading away service scope or delivery reliability. c3 (second-source resilience) is relevant to delivery risk but not actionable in a single decision this cycle, so I leave it for next review.
